'''Takuya Eguchi''' (Japanese: '''江口拓也''' ''Eguchi Takuya'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Eguchi was born on May 22, 1987, in the {{wp|Setagaya}} {{wp|Special wards of Tokyo|special ward}} of {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. As an adult, he became a voice actor and is affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}. Eguchi provided his voice for fledgling [[Aspertia City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Cheren]] in {{aniseries|BW}} of {{aniseries|PTS}}. Then, he voiced {{OBP|Blue|Origins}} during the [[Pokémon Origins]] miniseries.
